US revokes over 600 visas in birth tourism crackdown

The United States has revoked more than 600 visas as part of a crackdown on "birth tourism." Senator Marco Rubio stated that the visas were revoked. The Trump administration also launched a task force named 'End Birth Tourism.' This action targets individuals seeking to enter the US to give birth, thereby obtaining US citizenship for their children.
